questions.q:
Ravi's monthly salary is ₹16,000. He spends 30% of his salary on rent, 20% of his salary on education. 60% of the remaining amount is invested in mutual funds. Find the amount invested in mutual funds in a month.

रवि का मासिक वेतन ₹16,000 है। वह अपने वेतन का 30% किराये पर और 20% शिक्षा पर व्यय करता है। शेष धनराशि का 60% म्यूचुअल फंड में निवेश करता है, तो एक महीने में म्यूचुअल फंड में निवेश की गई धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.s:
Remaining salary of Ravi = [16000 X (100 - 30 - 20)]/100 = ₹8000

Amount invested in mutual funds = 0.60 X 8000 = ₹4800

questions.q:
At an event there are 500 guests, among whom 28% are adult males, 64% are adult females, and the rest are children. Find the total number of children at the event.

एक कार्यक्रम में 500 अतिथि हैं, जिनमें से 28% वयस्क पुरुष, 64% वयस्क महिलाएँ और शेष बच्चे हैं। इस कार्यक्रम में बच्चों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Percentage of children at the event = (100 - 28 - 64) = 8%

Number of children at the event = 0.08 X 500 = 40

questions.q:
A person spends 30% of his salary. Salary of the person increases by 40% and savings increases by 10%. Find the percentage increase in the expenditure of the person.

एक व्यक्ति अपने वेतन का 30% व्यय करता है। व्यक्ति के वेतन में 40% की वृद्धि होती है और बचत में 10% की वृद्धि होती है। व्यक्ति के व्यय में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.s:
Let, salary of the person = Rs. 100x

Expenditure of the person = 100x * 30/100 = Rs. 30x

Savings of the person = Rs. 70x

Salary after increment = 100x * 140/100 = Rs. 140x

Savings after increment = 70x * 110/100 = Rs. 77

Expenditure after increment = 140x - 77x = Rs. 63x

Required percentage increase in expenditure = (63x - 30x)/30x * 100 = 33/30 * 100 = 110%

questions.q:
In the election, 8% of the voters did not cast their votes. Two candidates contested the election in which the winning candidate got 48% of the total votes and won election by 1100 votes. Find the total number of voters in the election, given that all the votes cast were valid.

एक चुनाव में 8% मतदाता वोट नहीं देते हैं। ये चुनाव दो उम्मीदवार लड़ते हैं जिसमें जीतने वाले उम्मीदवार ने कुल वोट के 48% वोट प्राप्त किए और इस प्रकार उसने 1100 वोट से चुनाव जीता। यह दिया गया है कि दिए गए सभी वोट वैध है, तो चुनाव में मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let total number of votes = 100x

So, total number of votes cast = 100x * 92/100 = 92x

Number of votes cast for winner = 100x * 48/100 = 48x

Thus, number of votes cast for looser = 92x - 48x = 44x

Winner won election by 1100 votes.

=> 48x - 44x = 1100

=> x = 1100/4

=> x = 275

Hence, total number of votes = 27500

questions.q:
If price of a commodity increases by 25% then, by how much percent should consumption be reduced so that total expenditure rises by only 10%.

यदि एक वस्तु के मूल्य में 25% की वृद्धि होती है, तो वस्तु के उपभोग में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी की जानी चाहिए जिससे कि कुल व्यय में केवल 10% की वृद्धि हो।

Sale of almonds in a store in July and August is increased by 60% and 50% respectively as compared to that in previous month. If 105.6 kg almonds sold in August, then how much more almonds sold in July as compared to that in previous month?

जुलाई और अगस्त में एक दुकान में बादाम की बिक्री पिछले महीने की तुलना में क्रमशः 60% और 50% अधिक हुई। यदि अगस्त में 105.6 kg बादाम बेचे गये, तो जुलाई में पिछले महीने की तुलना में कितने अधिक बादाम बेचे गये?
questions.s:
Sale of almonds in August = 105.6 kg

Sale of almonds in July = 105.6 * 100/(100 + 50) = 70.4 kg

Sale of almonds in June = 70.4 * 100/(100 + 60) = 44 kg

Therefore, difference = 70.4 - 44 = 26.4 kg

questions.q:
P is 10% more than Q and Q is 10% more than R. Then by what percent is P more than R?

P, Q से 10% अधिक है और Q, R से 10% अधिक है, तो P, R से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक है?
questions.s:
Let R = 100 units

Q = 100 * 110% = 110 units

P = 110 * 110% = 121 units

Required percentage = = 21%

Alternate method:

Required percentage = 10 + 10 + = 21%

questions.q:
In a shooting game, Nishu has a hitting rate of 70% to hit his target out of X number of attempts. He missed the target 30 times in a row, and his hitting rate down to 40%. Find the total number of attempts attempted by Nishu.

एक निशानेबाजी के खेल में, अपने लक्ष्य पर निशाना लगाने के लिए संख्या X के प्रयासों में से नीशू की निशाना लगाने की दर 70% है। वह लगातार 30 बार लक्ष्य से चूक जाता है और उसकी निशाना लगाने की दर 40% तक गिर जाती है। नीशू द्वारा निशाना लगाने के लिए किए गए प्रयासों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Number of attempts in first case = X

Number of attempts hit on target = 70X/100 = 7X/10

According to the question,

(7X/10)/ (X + 30) = 40/100

7X/(10X + 300) = 2/5

35X = 20X + 600

15X = 600

X = 40

Total number of attempts attempted by Nishu = 40 + 30 = 70.

questions.q:
If Amit's salary is 60% more than Ajay's salary, then Ajay's salary is what percent less than the salary of Amit?

यदि अमित का वेतन, अजय के वेतन से 60% अधिक है, तो अजय का वेतन, अमित के वेतन से कितने प्रतिशत कम है?
questions.s:
Let Amit's salary be S and Ajay's salary be T

S = 1.6T

T = (1/1.6) x S = 0.625 S = 62.5% of S

Ajay's salary is 37.5% less than the salary of Amit.

questions.q:
Two candidates P and Q contested in an election. 20% of the total votes are invalid. P got 65% of the total valid votes and won by 600 votes. Find the number of invalid votes.

दो उम्मीदवारों P और Q ने एक चुनाव लड़ा। कुल मतों में से 20% मत अवैध हैं। P को कुल वैध मतों के 65% मत प्राप्त हुए और वह 600 मतों से जीत गया। अवैध मतों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Percentage of valid votes Q got = 35%

Given,

65% - 35% = 600

30% = 600

100% = 2000

Total valid votes = 2000

Percentage of invalid votes = 20%

Therefore,

Number of invalid votes = 2000 * 20/80 = 500

questions.q:
In a village, 18% of the total population left due to flood. Out of the remaining population, 28% migrated to town. If the current population of the village is 2952, then what was the population before the flood?

एक गांव में बाढ़ के कारण कुल आबादी का 18% हिस्सा गांव छोड़कर चला गया। शेष आबादी में से 28% लोग शहर चले गए। यदि गांव की वर्तमान जनसंख्या 2952 है, तो बाढ़ से पहले जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
questions.s:
Let the total population of a village be '100X'

The population of the village after flood = 100X * 82/100 = 82X

The current population of the village = 82X * 72/100

2952 = 82X * 72/100

X = 2952 * 100/ (72 * 82)

X = 50

Hence, the population before the flood = 5000

questions.q:
When 30% of M is subtracted from 60% of N, then the resultant is -3. The sum of 25% of M and 45% of N is 31. What is the difference between M and N?

जब N के 60% में से M का 30% घटाया जाता है, तो परिणामी -3 प्राप्त होता है। M के 25% और N के 45% का योगफल 31 है। M और N के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

In a test consisting of 75 questions carrying one mark each, Samir answered 75% of the first 40 questions correctly. What approximate percent of the other 35 questions does he need to answer correctly to score 80% in the entire test?

किसी परीक्षा में एक अंक वाले 75 प्रश्न थे। समीर ने पहले 40 प्रश्नों में से 75% प्रश्नों का सही उत्तर दिया। संपूर्ण परीक्षा में 80% अंक प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे अन्य 35 प्रश्नों में से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर देने की आवश्यकता है?
questions.s:
Total questions he need to answer correctly = 75 x 0.8 = 60

He answers 0.75x40 = 30 correct out of first 40.

So he must answer 30 correct out of the remaining 35

Required % = 30/35 x 100 = 85.71% = 86%

questions.q:
70% of students in a coaching institute are males out of which 80% are vegetarian. If 49 male students are non-vegetarian, then how many female students are there in the coaching institute?

एक कोचिंग संस्थान में 70% विद्यार्थी पुरुष हैं, जिनमें से 80% शाकाहारी हैं। यदि 49 पुरुष विद्यार्थी माँसाहारी हैं, तो कोचिंग संस्थान में कितनी महिला विद्यार्थी हैं?
questions.s:
In coaching institute:

Let the total number of students = n

Then, number of male students = 70% of n = 0.7n

And the number of male students who are non-vegetarian = (100 - 80)% of 0.7n = 0.14n

Then, 49 = 0.14n

n = 350

Therefore, number of female students = n - 0.7n = 0.3n = 0.3 * 350 = 105

questions.q:
The number of people who visited cinema hall is increased by 15% and the price of ticket per person is decreased by 10%, then it results in what percentage increase in total revenue?

सिनेमा हॉल जाने वालों व्यक्तियों की संख्या में 15% की वृद्धि होती है और प्रति व्यक्ति टिकट की कीमत में 10% की कमी होती है, तो इसके परिणामस्वरूप कुल राजस्व में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होती है?
questions.s:
As we know that,

Price * Number of people = Total revenue

Percentage increase in total revenue = 35*100/1000= 3.5%.

questions.q:
When numerator and denominator of a fraction are increased by 50% and 75% respectively, then the fraction becomes 5/6. What is the actual fraction?

जब किसी भिन्न के अंश और हर में क्रमशः 50% और 75% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो भिन्न 5/6 हो जाती है। वास्तविक भिन्न क्या है?

The difference between 38% of a number and 24% of the same number is 135.10. What is 60% of that number

किसी संख्या के 38% और समान संख्या के 24% के बीच का अंतर 135.10 है। उस संख्या का 60% क्या है?
questions.s:
According to the question,

38% - 24% of number = 135.10

14% of number = 135.10

60% of number = 135.1 x 60/14 = 579

questions.q:
A leader gets 35% votes but 480 less than the winning leader. How many votes does the losing leader get?

एक नेता को 35% मत प्राप्त हुए लेकिन जीतने वाले नेता से 480 मत कम प्राप्त हुए। हारने वाले नेता को कितने मत प्राप्त हुए हैं?
questions.s:
Percentage difference between the votes of winning and losing leader = 65% - 35% = 30%

Given,

30% = 480

35% = 480 * 35/30 = 560

questions.q:
A gave 30% of his amount to B and 30% of the remaining amount to C. If C has ₹1176, then find the amount that A gave to B.

A अपनी धनराशि का 30% भाग B को और शेष धनराशि का 30% भाग C को देता है। यदि C के पास ₹1176 है, तो A द्वारा B को दी गई धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let the amount = ₹100a

30% of (100 - 30)%*100a = 1176

a = 1176/21

a = 56

So, the amount that A gave to B = 30% of 5600 = ₹1680

questions.q:
Salary of A, B and C are in the ratio of 4 : 5 : 3. If A, B and C donate their 10%, 25% and 15% respectively from their salary. Find the remaining salary of A, B and C together if salary of C is Rs. 36000.

A, B और C का वेतन 4 : 5 : 3 के अनुपात में है। यदि A, B और C अपने वेतन से क्रमशः 10%, 25% और 15% दान करते हैं। यदि C का वेतन रु.36000 है, तो एक साथ A, B और C का शेष वेतन ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.s:
Let the salary of A, B and C be 4x, 5x and 3x respectively

According to question,

3x = 36000

x = 12000

Salary of A and B is 48000 and 60000 respectively

Remaining salary of A after donation = 90% of 48000 = Rs. 43,200

Remaining salary of B after donation = 75% of 60000 = Rs. 45,000

Remaining salary of C after donation = 85% of 36000 = Rs. 30,600

Required total = 43200 + 45000 + 30600 = Rs. 1,18,800

Ajay's salary is 37.5% less than the salary of Amit.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Two candidates P and Q contested in an election. 20% of the total votes are invalid. P got 65% of the total valid votes and won by 600 votes. Find the number of invalid votes.

दो उम्मीदवारों P और Q ने एक चुनाव लड़ा। कुल मतों में से 20% मत अवैध हैं। P को कुल वैध मतों के 65% मत प्राप्त हुए और वह 600 मतों से जीत गया। अवैध मतों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Percentage of valid votes Q got = 35%

Given,

65% - 35% = 600

30% = 600

100% = 2000

Total valid votes = 2000

Percentage of invalid votes = 20%

Therefore,

Number of invalid votes = 2000 * 20/80 = 500

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a village, 18% of the total population left due to flood. Out of the remaining population, 28% migrated to town. If the current population of the village is 2952, then what was the population before the flood?

एक गांव में बाढ़ के कारण कुल आबादी का 18% हिस्सा गांव छोड़कर चला गया। शेष आबादी में से 28% लोग शहर चले गए। यदि गांव की वर्तमान जनसंख्या 2952 है, तो बाढ़ से पहले जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the total population of a village be '100X'

The population of the village after flood = 100X * 82/100 = 82X

The current population of the village = 82X * 72/100

2952 = 82X * 72/100

X = 2952 * 100/ (72 * 82)

X = 50

Hence, the population before the flood = 5000

questions_hin.q_hi:
When 30% of M is subtracted from 60% of N, then the resultant is -3. The sum of 25% of M and 45% of N is 31. What is the difference between M and N?

जब N के 60% में से M का 30% घटाया जाता है, तो परिणामी -3 प्राप्त होता है। M के 25% और N के 45% का योगफल 31 है। M और N के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

In a test consisting of 75 questions carrying one mark each, Samir answered 75% of the first 40 questions correctly. What approximate percent of the other 35 questions does he need to answer correctly to score 80% in the entire test?

किसी परीक्षा में एक अंक वाले 75 प्रश्न थे। समीर ने पहले 40 प्रश्नों में से 75% प्रश्नों का सही उत्तर दिया। संपूर्ण परीक्षा में 80% अंक प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे अन्य 35 प्रश्नों में से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर देने की आवश्यकता है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Total questions he need to answer correctly = 75 x 0.8 = 60

He answers 0.75x40 = 30 correct out of first 40.

So he must answer 30 correct out of the remaining 35

Required % = 30/35 x 100 = 85.71% = 86%

questions_hin.q_hi:
70% of students in a coaching institute are males out of which 80% are vegetarian. If 49 male students are non-vegetarian, then how many female students are there in the coaching institute?

एक कोचिंग संस्थान में 70% विद्यार्थी पुरुष हैं, जिनमें से 80% शाकाहारी हैं। यदि 49 पुरुष विद्यार्थी माँसाहारी हैं, तो कोचिंग संस्थान में कितनी महिला विद्यार्थी हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
In coaching institute:

Let the total number of students = n

Then, number of male students = 70% of n = 0.7n

And the number of male students who are non-vegetarian = (100 - 80)% of 0.7n = 0.14n

Then, 49 = 0.14n

n = 350

Therefore, number of female students = n - 0.7n = 0.3n = 0.3 * 350 = 105

questions_hin.q_hi:
The number of people who visited cinema hall is increased by 15% and the price of ticket per person is decreased by 10%, then it results in what percentage increase in total revenue?

सिनेमा हॉल जाने वालों व्यक्तियों की संख्या में 15% की वृद्धि होती है और प्रति व्यक्ति टिकट की कीमत में 10% की कमी होती है, तो इसके परिणामस्वरूप कुल राजस्व में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होती है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
As we know that,

Price * Number of people = Total revenue

Percentage increase in total revenue = 35*100/1000= 3.5%.

questions_hin.q_hi:
When numerator and denominator of a fraction are increased by 50% and 75% respectively, then the fraction becomes 5/6. What is the actual fraction?

जब किसी भिन्न के अंश और हर में क्रमशः 50% और 75% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो भिन्न 5/6 हो जाती है। वास्तविक भिन्न क्या है?

The difference between 38% of a number and 24% of the same number is 135.10. What is 60% of that number

किसी संख्या के 38% और समान संख्या के 24% के बीच का अंतर 135.10 है। उस संख्या का 60% क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
According to the question,

38% - 24% of number = 135.10

14% of number = 135.10

60% of number = 135.1 x 60/14 = 579

questions_hin.q_hi:
A leader gets 35% votes but 480 less than the winning leader. How many votes does the losing leader get?

एक नेता को 35% मत प्राप्त हुए लेकिन जीतने वाले नेता से 480 मत कम प्राप्त हुए। हारने वाले नेता को कितने मत प्राप्त हुए हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Percentage difference between the votes of winning and losing leader = 65% - 35% = 30%

Given,

30% = 480

35% = 480 * 35/30 = 560

questions_hin.q_hi:
A gave 30% of his amount to B and 30% of the remaining amount to C. If C has ₹1176, then find the amount that A gave to B.

A अपनी धनराशि का 30% भाग B को और शेष धनराशि का 30% भाग C को देता है। यदि C के पास ₹1176 है, तो A द्वारा B को दी गई धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the amount = ₹100a

30% of (100 - 30)%*100a = 1176

a = 1176/21

a = 56

So, the amount that A gave to B = 30% of 5600 = ₹1680

questions_hin.q_hi:
Salary of A, B and C are in the ratio of 4 : 5 : 3. If A, B and C donate their 10%, 25% and 15% respectively from their salary. Find the remaining salary of A, B and C together if salary of C is Rs. 36000.

A, B और C का वेतन 4 : 5 : 3 के अनुपात में है। यदि A, B और C अपने वेतन से क्रमशः 10%, 25% और 15% दान करते हैं। यदि C का वेतन रु.36000 है, तो एक साथ A, B और C का शेष वेतन ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the salary of A, B and C be 4x, 5x and 3x respectively

According to question,

3x = 36000

x = 12000

Salary of A and B is 48000 and 60000 respectively

Remaining salary of A after donation = 90% of 48000 = Rs. 43,200

Remaining salary of B after donation = 75% of 60000 = Rs. 45,000

Remaining salary of C after donation = 85% of 36000 = Rs. 30,600

Required total = 43200 + 45000 + 30600 = Rs. 1,18,800
